description_for_human: Query your Orbis professional knowledge graph from ChatGPT — summary, experiences, skills, and relationships inline.
description_for_model: Access the authenticated user's Orbis knowledge graph (read-only). Tools cover: profile summary (name, headline, counts), nodes by type (work_experience, skill, education, certification, language, publication, project, patent, award, outreach, training), the full graph in a hero-node sub-view, connections of a specific node, and skills used in a specific work experience or project. Each tool response carries _meta.openai/outputTemplate referencing a ui://widget/* resource that ChatGPT renders inline.
_notes: schema_version is provisional — adapt to whatever OpenAI's submission dashboard requires at submit time.
logo_url paths point at static assets that need to be uploaded to frontend/public/chatgpt-apps/ before submission.
Country availability + localization fields are filled in via the dashboard wizard, not via this manifest.
